edit.description: `NotShippedAttempt` variant on the `PriorAttempt` union and its `<prior-attempt>` render — merged sha and touched paths, no reason vocabulary.

Write the record under the entry's key on the `!shipVerdict` leg (:2728); a later clean ship clears it by the existing path. Exclude `not-shipped` from `superviseLoop`'s errored derivation, as `voluntary-bail` already is (spec/loop.md, *No interpretation fields*).

summary: A `not-shipped` `PriorAttempt` on the chain's `shipped: false` — the park two chains rebuilt from the verdict log, on the channel `TickContext.priorAttempts` already carries

per.section: Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick

tests: a `shipped: false` verdict leaves a `not-shipped` prior-attempt record under the entry's key, carrying the merged sha and touched paths
the next tick's `TickContext.priorAttempts` carries it, and a later clean ship clears the slot
a run whose only no-commit fact is `not-shipped` is not derived as errored
acceptance: A chain answers "was the last build a park" from `priorAttempts` alone; the pins fail on the pre-fix tree.
notes: Closes the parked fork — the human ruled it the prior-attempt record, not a `TickContext` merge-outcome field (07e77d3). Two chains livelocked on the missing channel and each fixed it by reading the verdict log: flume's `plan.shouldRun` (4ee48ee), cascade's `build.handoff`.

edit.description: Report it on both `TickResult` returns; `setupFailedIndices` (:2333) currently reaches no surface. The `entries` map at :2716 already omits a setup-failed tag by lookup — pin that, don't rebuild it.

summary: `TickResult.provisionFailures` — an entry whose create or `setupWorktree` failed reports on the handoff surface instead of appearing in `entries` with every flag false
tests: a fanout entry whose `setupWorktree` hook throws reaches `handoff` under `provisionFailures` with its tag, and is absent from `entries`
its siblings still run, ship, and appear in `entries`
acceptance: A chain reconciling a failed provision names the entry from `TickResult` alone; the pins fail on the pre-fix tree.
notes: Closes the parked enumeration question — spec/worktrees.md and spec/chain.md now name the field (07e77d3). The dispatcher-side behaviour (isolate, skip the agent, still tear down, siblings proceed) already ships; only the reporting surface is missing.

edit.description: `GateResult.skipped?: string` — the fact that `ok` was not earned by running a judge. `ok` stays required and stays the verdict.
Copy onto `TickVerdictGateResult` (:199) verbatim, beside `details`; interpret no further.
`chainLoadGate`'s untouched-chain green (:257) is the standing instance — declare the reason instead of spelling it into `message`.

summary: `GateResult.skipped?: string` — a gate spells a verdict no judge earned, and the engine copies the reason onto the verdict's gate result verbatim
tests: a gate returning `skipped` lands its reason on the tick verdict's gate row unchanged
`chainLoadGate` over a commit that touched no chain file returns `ok: true` with a `skipped` reason
a gate that returned `ok: true` without `skipped` leaves no `skipped` on its verdict row
acceptance: A verdict reader tells a passed gate from a gate that never ran, without parsing `message`; the pins fail on the pre-fix tree.
notes: `engineering.md`, *A green verdict is proven non-vacuous*: vacuous-by-design is spelled, never inherited. Today the only signal is prose inside `message` ("chain.ts untouched — gate skipped"), which is exactly the pattern-match the engine refuses elsewhere.

edit.description: `baseSha` on `TickVerdictMergeOutcome` beside `headSha` (:290). Singleton emits no span row at all today — `mergeOutcomes` is fanout-only and `commitSha` is set only on success, so a gate-reverted singleton commit's sha survives nowhere on the verdict.

summary: The verdict's span row carries the span's base sha — and a singleton tick gains a span row at all, so its reverted commit is re-cherry-pickable from the verdict alone

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

tests: a fanout entry's span row carries the base it branched from beside its head sha
a singleton tick reverted by an afterCommit gate leaves a span row naming both shas
acceptance: Every span the verdict records is re-cherry-pickable from base and head without re-running the agent; the pins fail on the pre-fix tree.
notes: The singleton half is pre-existing drift the base-sha widening surfaces: the section's "the phase's own single span under singleton" has never held for `headSha` either. Verified on disk this tick — `runSingleton`'s return sets no `mergeOutcomes`, and the afterCommit revert at :1946 drops `postWtHead` after `buildPriorAttempt`.

edit.description: :1074's missing-chain error tells the consumer to write the shape :1102 refuses 30 lines later. :1040's docstring still lists pre-0.10 validation ("a shape that isn't a Chain") — f6fef79 moved this block onto its symbol without correcting it.

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

the scanned corpus covers `examples/`'s chain modules, the surface engine-boundary.md names as opinion's home

notes: Audit of f6fef79 and the examples/ sweep found the same defect. Hazard the pin must clear: CHAIN-AUTHORING.md:39 denies this shape in the same verbs an assertion uses — the case this file already met once and answered with an inventory (ALLOWED_ENV_MENTIONS); a regex tight enough to split assertion from denial is the alternative. examples/ carries neither existing needle today, so the widening stays green on its own.
